    p = f["point"].to_numpy()

    rows[n] = dict(mape=m(a,p), rmse=float(np.sqrt(np.mean((a-p)**2))), mae=float(np.mean(np.abs(a-p))), jan1=m(a[jan1],p[jan1]), rest=m(a[~jan1],p[~jan1]))
